scope: Mathematical/value/SL model, not intrinsic C implementation or ISA theorem

domain.K: arbitrary positive with kc=4*K and machine_capacity
domain.packed_W: ceil(nc/8) panels, each [8 f32 bias][K*8 f32 weight], including full padded NR8 panel
domain.C: 4*nc writable fp32 slots, initialization not required; output relation only active mr*nc; unused physical rows retained as undef resource
domain.alias: logical absent rows alias min(row,mr-1); one physical owner, repeat writes handled, no four-row-independent precondition
domain.fp32: all modeled binary32 values including NaN, Inf, subnormal and signed zero; no finite-only or lo<=hi requirement

observation.public_outputs: active output numerical equality or both NaN; +0/-0 equal
observation.internal_bit_same: Coq fp32 value equality, stronger than public observation; does not mean fp32_eq(NaN,NaN)
observation.rounding_and_modes: mathematical fused round-to-nearest ties-to-even, no flush; current NEON value reference AH=0; physical environment correspondence not proved
